    (hselected : ∀ x∈_root_.ThreeSum.ReportingHostWantedControls.record S, |x|≤lim.word)

theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $\lambda,\mu,d$ be run limits, memory and depth. Let $S$ be a wanted selection record and $L$ a scratch layout, stored at headers $a_s,a_l$. Fix cover and counter addresses, microblock parameter $h$, block count $J$, reporting depth $K$, budget $T$, and postcondition $Q$. Assume the cover header stores the selected local prime and bucket cap; addresses fit words; $d$ permits a nested call; the complete loader-space bound fits memory; all selected record values fit words; and all layout values fit the address space. If the guarded reporter at depth $d+1$, with the arguments determined by these records, meets $Q$ within $T$, then its packed-record adapter meets

$$Q\quad\text{within }T+4000\text{ steps}.$$

Its argument list consists of the two headers, $h,J,K$, the computed block-source modulus, cover and counter addresses.

This accounts for loading the actual retained records before invoking the complete wanted reporter.
